content: To know reality you must look at it directly, not through the screen of symbols, words, and numbers.
author: Alan Watts
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. Most human unhappiness exists in two places that don't currently exist: the past, which cannot be changed, and the future, which hasn't happened yet. Meanwhile, the only life you will ever experience is slipping past unnoticed.

Alan Watts understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Presence is not a rare mystical achievement; it is simply having the courtesy to show up for your own life. When you anchor your awareness in the immediate room and task, the frantic anxieties of the ego dissolve.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
